_comment: County variables from outside the platform's own layers, registered for
the adaptive feature search. Drop a fips-keyed CSV under data/features/,
add an entry below, and the next county_features.py run adds its columns
to the candidate pool; feature_search.py then ranks them with everything
else. No code change is needed to widen the search.
Per column: name (the feature name; must not collide with an existing
one), label, tier (1 low detection-bias exposure, 3 high), transform
(identity, log1p, log10), leakage_class (none unless the column carries
outcome information; only 'none' can reach the production model).
